grammar.purpose: Identify whom an emotion or concern is directed toward
grammar.explanation: 我为你高兴 and 我为她担心 identify the person an emotion concerns. This object use extends, rather than repeats, the earlier beneficiary use 为朋友打印材料. Both use wèi, unlike wéi in 成为. Concern does not authorize deciding for the person; 我替她决定 acts in her place. Preserve the distinction between a feeling toward someone and an action intended to benefit them.

examples.zh: 我为你高兴，但不替你决定。
examples.py: wǒ wèi nǐ gāo xìng , dàn bù tì nǐ jué dìng .
examples.en: I am happy for you but do not decide for you.

examples.py: tā wèi péng you de shēn tǐ dān xīn .
examples.en: She is concerned about her friend’s health.

examples.zh: 别为我的选择着急，我会先问清楚。
examples.py: bié wèi wǒ de xuǎn zé zháo jí , wǒ huì xiān wèn qīng chǔ .
examples.en: Do not worry about my choice; I will clarify it first.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我为她担心，所以她必须听我的。
commonMistakes.right: 我为她担心，也尊重她自己的选择。
commonMistakes.why: Concern is directed toward a person without removing their agency.

grammar.purpose: State a perspective rather than a universal judgement
grammar.explanation: 对我来说，安静很重要 locates the judgement in the speaker’s perspective. It does not establish that everyone prefers silence. 对新会员来说 also allows a group perspective, but avoid asserting uniform preferences without evidence. Compare 客观价格 with personally evaluated value.

examples.py: duì wǒ lái shuō , ān jìng hěn zhòng yào .

examples.zh: 对她来说，今天休息更合适。
examples.py: duì tā lái shuō , jīn tiān xiū xī gèng hé shì .
examples.en: For her, rest today is more appropriate.

examples.zh: 对新会员来说，先看说明比较方便。
examples.py: duì xīn huì yuán lái shuō , xiān kàn shuō míng bǐ jiào fāng biàn .
examples.en: For new members, reading the explanation first is more convenient.

commonMistakes.wrong: 对我来说重要，所以对所有人都重要。
commonMistakes.right: 对我来说重要，对方的需要还要问。
commonMistakes.why: A personal perspective does not generalize to everyone.

lines.zh: 今天还想去那个热闹的活动吗？
lines.py: jīn tiān hái xiǎng qù nà gè rè nào de huó dòng ma ?
lines.en: Do you still want to go to that lively event today?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我有点累，想找个安静的地方坐坐。
lines.py: wǒ yǒu diǎn lèi , xiǎng zhǎo gè ān jìng de dì fāng zuò zuò .
lines.en: I'm a little tired. I'd like somewhere quiet to sit.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我们去河边的小店吧，里面人少。
lines.py: nà wǒ men qù hé biān de xiǎo diàn ba , lǐ miàn rén shǎo .
lines.en: Let's go to the little shop by the river. It's quieter inside.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 会不会耽误你？你不是想看演出吗？
lines.py: huì bù huì dān wù nǐ ? nǐ bù shì xiǎng kàn yǎn chū ma ?
lines.en: Will that hold you up? Didn't you want to see the show?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 不急。对我来说，跟你见面更重要。
lines.py: bù jí . duì wǒ lái shuō , gēn nǐ jiàn miàn gèng zhòng yào .
lines.en: No rush. Meeting you matters more to me.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 谢谢。那家店我没去过，茶怎么样？
lines.py: xiè xiè . nà jiā diàn wǒ méi qù guò , chá zěn me yàng ?
lines.en: Thanks. I haven't been there. How's the tea?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 挺好，窗边还有两把椅子。我先问问有没有位子。
lines.py: tǐng hǎo , chuāng biān hái yǒu liǎng bǎ yǐ zi . wǒ xiān wèn wèn yǒu méi yǒu wèi zi .
lines.en: Good. There are two chairs by the window. I'll ask if they're available.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。我不想让你白跑，晚点还可以去听一首歌。
lines.py: hǎo . wǒ bù xiǎng ràng nǐ bái pǎo , wǎn diǎn hái kě yǐ qù tīng yī shǒu gē .
lines.en: Okay. I don't want to waste your trip. We could still hear a song later.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 先喝茶吧，喝完再看你想不想去。
lines.py: xiān hē chá ba , hē wán zài kàn nǐ xiǎng bù xiǎng qù .
lines.en: Let's have tea first and see how you feel afterwards.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行，你已经出门了吗？
lines.py: xíng , nǐ yǐ jīng chū mén le ma ?
lines.en: Okay. Have you left yet?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 还没。你到了，发消息给我。
lines.py: hái méi . nǐ dào le , fā xiāo xī gěi wǒ .
lines.en: Not yet. Message me when you arrive.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，我先慢慢走过去。
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ xiān màn màn zǒu guò qù .
lines.en: Okay. I'll walk over slowly.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: Value is not just a price
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 今天我和陈宇约好去听演出，出门以前却觉得累。我给他发消息，说想找一个安静的地方坐坐，他提议去河边的小店。
lines.py: jīn tiān wǒ hé chén yǔ yuē hǎo qù tīng yǎn chū , chū mén yǐ qián què jué de lèi . wǒ gěi tā fā xiāo xī , shuō xiǎng zhǎo yī gè ān jìng de dì fāng zuò zuò , tā tí yì qù hé biān de xiǎo diàn .
lines.en: Chen Yu and I had planned to see a performance today, but I felt tired before leaving. I messaged that I'd like somewhere quiet to sit; he suggested the little shop by the river.

lines.zh: 我怕他失望，问要不要他先去看演出。他说今天主要是想和我见面，演出下次也能听。我看到这句话，心里轻松了一点。
lines.py: wǒ pà tā shī wàng , wèn yào bù yào tā xiān qù kàn yǎn chū . tā shuō jīn tiān zhǔ yào shì xiǎng hé wǒ jiàn miàn , yǎn chū xià cì yě néng tīng . wǒ kàn dào zhè jù huà , xīn lǐ qīng sōng le yī diǎn .
lines.en: Worried he'd be disappointed, I asked if he'd like to go to the show first. He said he mainly wanted to see me today; the show could wait. Reading that made me feel more relaxed.

lines.zh: 到店里以后，我找了窗边的两把椅子。陈宇过来时带了一本薄书，说以前在那里读过，想给我看看。
lines.py: dào diàn lǐ yǐ hòu , wǒ zhǎo le chuāng biān de liǎng bǎ yǐ zi . chén yǔ guò lái shí dài le yī běn báo shū , shuō yǐ qián zài nà lǐ dú guò , xiǎng gěi wǒ kàn kàn .
lines.en: At the shop I found two chairs by the window. Chen Yu arrived with a slim book he'd read there before and wanted to show me.

lines.zh: 我们点了茶，他翻到里面的一张照片。照片里是一条我小时候走过的路，我指给他看。他说去年也去过那里，我们就聊起那条路旁边的小店。
lines.py: wǒ men diǎn le chá , tā fān dào lǐ miàn de yī zhāng zhào piān . zhào piān lǐ shì yī tiáo wǒ xiǎo shí hòu zǒu guò de lù , wǒ zhǐ gěi tā kàn . tā shuō qù nián yě qù guò nà lǐ , wǒ men jiù liáo qǐ nà tiáo lù páng biān de xiǎo diàn .
lines.en: We ordered tea. He turned to a photo of a road I'd walked along as a child. I pointed it out. He said he'd been there last year too, and we talked about the little shops beside that road.

lines.zh: 聊了一会儿，我不那么累了。他问还想不想去听歌，我说今天就坐在这里吧。这本书还没看完，茶也很好喝。
lines.py: liáo le yī huì er , wǒ bù nà me lèi le . tā wèn hái xiǎng bù xiǎng qù tīng gē , wǒ shuō jīn tiān jiù zuò zài zhè lǐ ba . zhè běn shū hái méi kàn wán , chá yě hěn hǎo hē .
lines.en: After chatting I felt less tired. He asked if I wanted to hear music now. I'd rather stay here today, I said; I hadn't finished the book and the tea was good.

lines.zh: 傍晚我们一起走到车站。他说下次还坐窗边，我说好，不过这次的书先借我。他把书递来，说椅子不能借，书可以。
lines.py: bàng wǎn wǒ men yì qǐ zǒu dào chē zhàn . tā shuō xià cì hái zuò chuāng biān , wǒ shuō hǎo , bù guò zhè cì de shū xiān jiè wǒ . tā bǎ shū dì lái , shuō yǐ zi bù néng jiè , shū kě yǐ .
lines.en: That evening we walked to the station together. He suggested the window seats again next time. Yes, I said, but could I borrow today's book first? He handed it over: the chairs couldn't be borrowed, but the book could.

choices: Tea, a shared memory and a borrowed book

lines.zh: 她一直把这件事放在心上。
lines.py: tā yì zhí bǎ zhè jiàn shì fàng zài xīn shàng .
lines.en: She keeps this matter close to her heart.

lines.zh: 你的心还在那座小城吧？
lines.py: nǐ de xīn hái zài nà zuò xiǎo chéng ba ?
lines.en: Your heart's still in that little town, isn't it?

lines.zh: 这本书介绍了他的思想。
lines.py: zhè běn shū jiè shào le tā de sī xiǎng .
lines.en: This book introduces his ideas.

lines.zh: 旅行改变了我的思想。
lines.py: lǚ xíng gǎi biàn le wǒ de sī xiǎng .
lines.en: Travel changed my thinking.

lines.zh: 对我来说，这张照片很有价值。
lines.py: duì wǒ lái shuō , zhè zhāng zhào piān hěn yǒu jià zhí .
lines.en: This photo has great value to me.

lines.zh: 这件事的价值不在于花了多少钱。
lines.py: zhè jiàn shì de jià zhí bù zài yú huā le duō shao qián .
lines.en: Its value isn't in how much it cost.

lines.zh: 第一次自己出门，对我很有意义。
lines.py: dì yī cì zì jǐ chū mén , duì wǒ hěn yǒu yì yì .
lines.en: Going out on my own for the first time meant a lot to me.

lines.zh: 这句话还有别的意义吗？
lines.py: zhè jù huà hái yǒu bié de yì yì ma ?
lines.en: Does this sentence have another meaning?

lines.zh: 这是我的个人选择。
lines.py: zhè shì wǒ de gè rén xuǎn zé .
lines.en: This is my personal choice.

lines.zh: 个人物品请随身带好。
lines.py: gè rén wù pǐn qǐng suí shēn dài hǎo .
lines.en: Please keep your personal belongings with you.

lines.zh: 先想想自身的问题，再怪别人。
lines.py: xiān xiǎng xiǎng zì shēn de wèn tí , zài guài bié ren .
lines.en: Think about your own problems before blaming others.

lines.zh: 课程可以根据自身需要来选。
lines.py: kè chéng kě yǐ gēn jù zì shēn xū yào lái xuǎn .
lines.en: You can choose a course to suit your own needs.

lines.zh: 午饭时间大家自主安排。
lines.py: wǔ fàn shí jiān dà jiā zì zhǔ ān pái .
lines.en: Everyone can arrange their own lunch break.

lines.zh: 学生可以自主选择一个题目。
lines.py: xué sheng kě yǐ zì zhǔ xuǎn zé yī gè tí mù .
lines.en: Students can choose a topic independently.

lines.zh: 谢谢你理解我的想法。
lines.py: xiè xiè nǐ lǐ jiě wǒ de xiǎng fǎ .
lines.en: Thank you for understanding my thinking.

lines.zh: 我不太理解这句话。
lines.py: wǒ bù tài lǐ jiě zhè jù huà .
lines.en: I don't quite understand this sentence.

lines.zh: 我打电话时，对方没接。
lines.py: wǒ dǎ diàn huà shí , duì fāng méi jiē .
lines.en: The other person didn't answer when I called.

lines.zh: 先听听对方怎么说。
lines.py: xiān tīng tīng duì fāng zěn me shuō .
lines.en: Let's hear what the other person has to say first.

lines.zh: 这次活动的对象是新生。
lines.py: zhè cì huó dòng de duì xiàng shì xīn shēng .
lines.en: This event is aimed at new students.

lines.zh: 你想送礼物的对象是谁？
lines.py: nǐ xiǎng sòng lǐ wù de duì xiàng shì shéi ?
lines.en: Who are you thinking of giving the gift to?

lines.zh: 这个价格比较合理。
lines.py: zhè gè jià gé bǐ jiào hé lǐ .
lines.en: This price is fairly reasonable.

lines.zh: 你说的理由很合理。
lines.py: nǐ shuō de lǐ yóu hěn hé lǐ .
lines.en: Your reason is reasonable.

lines.zh: 我想听一个客观的评价。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng tīng yī gè kè guān de píng jià .
lines.en: I'd like an objective assessment.

lines.zh: 她尽量客观地介绍两种办法。
lines.py: tā jǐn liàng kè guān de jiè shào liǎng zhǒng bàn fǎ .
lines.en: She tries to present both approaches objectively.

lines.zh: 搬家以后，我才体会到她的辛苦。
lines.py: bān jiā yǐ hòu , wǒ cái tǐ huì dào tā de xīn kǔ .
lines.en: Only after moving did I appreciate how hard she'd worked.

lines.zh: 这次旅行，你有什么体会？
lines.py: zhè cì lǚ xíng , nǐ yǒu shén me tǐ huì ?
lines.en: What did you learn from this trip?

lines.zh: 周末去体验一下做陶杯吧。
lines.py: zhōu mò qù tǐ yàn yī xià zuò táo bēi ba .
lines.en: Let's try making pottery cups this weekend.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次坐船的体验。
lines.py: zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì zuò chuán de tǐ yàn .
lines.en: This is my first experience of travelling by boat.

lines.zh: 这个房间体现了她的喜好。
lines.py: zhè gè fáng jiān tǐ xiàn le tā de xǐ hào .
lines.en: This room reflects her preferences.

lines.zh: 这些细节体现了他的用心。
lines.py: zhè xiē xì jié tǐ xiàn le tā de yòng xīn .
lines.en: These details show the care he put in.

lines.zh: 这两张照片很相似。
lines.py: zhè liǎng zhāng zhào piān hěn xiāng sì .
lines.en: These two photos are very similar.

lines.zh: 我们的经历有点相似。
lines.py: wǒ men de jīng lì yǒu diǎn xiāng sì .
lines.en: Our experiences are somewhat similar.

lines.zh: 灯都关了，显然已经没人了。
lines.py: dēng dōu guān le , xiǎn rán yǐ jīng méi rén le .
lines.en: All the lights are off. Clearly there's no one left.

lines.zh: 显然，我又带错钥匙了。
lines.py: xiǎn rán , wǒ yòu dài cuò yào shi le .
lines.en: Clearly I've brought the wrong keys again.

lines.zh: 你最近身体状况怎么样？
lines.py: nǐ zuì jìn shēn tǐ zhuàng kuàng zěn me yàng ?
lines.en: How's your health been recently?

lines.zh: 先看看路上的状况再出发。
lines.py: xiān kàn kàn lù shàng de zhuàng kuàng zài chū fā .
lines.en: Check the conditions on the road before leaving.

audio.zh: 不急。对我来说，跟你见面更重要。
audio.py: bù jí . duì wǒ lái shuō , gēn nǐ jiàn miàn gèng zhòng yào .
audio.en: No rush. Meeting you matters more to me.

audio.zh: 傍晚我们一起走到车站。他说下次还坐窗边，我说好，不过这次的书先借我。他把书递来，说椅子不能借，书可以。
audio.py: bàng wǎn wǒ men yì qǐ zǒu dào chē zhàn . tā shuō xià cì hái zuò chuāng biān , wǒ shuō hǎo , bù guò zhè cì de shū xiān jiè wǒ . tā bǎ shū dì lái , shuō yǐ zi bù néng jiè , shū kě yǐ .
audio.en: That evening we walked to the station together. He suggested the window seats again next time. Yes, I said, but could I borrow today's book first? He handed it over: the chairs couldn't be borrowed, but the book could.

2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Naturalness correction: a quiet tea/book meeting for a tired friend, Grandma sharing opera stories over a home visit, correcting a west/east gate mistake with an apology and water, and a handmade birthday book bag/photo card. No identity, copyright or assessment-policy lecture inside ordinary speech. All 88 word records retain IDs and get two independent contexts; abstract/formal senses use suitable separate sentences. Self-review: Chen Yu offers the quiet venue; Grandma expects Sunday three and oranges; only Lin An goes to wrong gate, Chen Yu sends old address and fetches her; blue cloth, ordinary gold-coloured five-yuan button, birthday recipient Xiao Zhou, two books fit. Every false statement contradicts its own clip.
